title: Korean student among 7 sued over group sexual assault at Cornell

blocks.text: A Korean student is among seven current and former Cornell University students named as defendants in a lawsuit involving the alleged group sexual assault of a female student, news reports said Sunday. According to The Cornell Daily Sun, the woman, a former Cornell student, filed the lawsuit in New York on Sept. 14, accusing the defendants, who were members of Cornell’s chapter of Chi Phi, a national fraternity with chapters at universities across the US, of forcing her to take drugs and sexually assaulting her at the fraternity house in October 2024.
